caption: The drawing depicts three views of a decorative object shaped like a conch shell, rendered in muted tones of brown, beige, grey-blue, and hints of red. The shell is detailed with carved lines and grooves, and it sits atop a round, slightly raised base ring with small cut-out triangular patterns. The object on the lower left is seen from the side and has the words "SHELL 1937" inscribed near the top edge. In the lower center position, the object is viewed from the front, highlighting the spiral tip and the open cavity inside the shell. In the top right corner, the shell is seen from above, showing a circular, metallic-looking insert with a dial or gauge in the middle that features the words “REGISTER SHELL” around its edge. The drawing is signed “W.O. Fletcher” in the bottom right corner. The background is plain, off-white, and unadorned.
title: Shell Out Bank
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
